relation_assertion_policy: Program/module mappings, dependency-chain assertions and literal repository slugs are preserved as source-authored relations. Endpoint identity, map-edge authorization, causal dependency and authority transfer are not performed by the parser.
status_policy: Claims of proof-of-concept simulators, benchmarks, open-source implementations and a module implementation collection are preserved as source-described program status. They do not create frozen-head implementation or execution standing for R25.
experimental_policy: docs/validation.md specifies observables, named tests and falsifiable hypotheses but reports no execution, empirical result, negative result or reproduction record.
absence_policy: The five-file frozen head is documentation-only. This bounded absence does not assert that named external modules lack implementations or results elsewhere.
temporal_policy: Current-head semantic parse is separate from the 18-commit developmental trajectory.
